title: Reminiscence
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1003617/description_03fd4e0c-95df-4605-a95e-3f47b6cb8768.png)

Discord Link

  ***  

![What is Reminiscence? Reminiscence is a modpack which aims to, much like the other modpacks of this field, combine the gameplay, aesthetics, and general design philosophies of Alpha and Beta versions with the convenience and creative options provided in Release versions. But, with a twist in the form of content mods which add to the experience. This modpack is not a 100% accurate Beta experience, and never will be nor will it claim to be. That's right, this isn't 100% nostalgia bait!  (It's actually 99% nostalgia bait.)](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1003617/description_460c4f15-1c1c-4c2c-ba37-ddb4eadc270b.png)  ***  

![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1003617/description_23fe8d37-8eb7-4fc9-a1c7-85d60e9b1f8d.png)

![Legacy Aesthetic & Gameplay Absence of hunger, sprinting, enchanting, & villagers/villages. Beta 1.7.3 terrain generation with all modern biomes (+ customizable presets!). Beta lighting. Beta textures & sounds (Courtesy of Golden Days, Programmer Art Ultimate, Minecraft: Classic Edition, Programmer Art Continuation Project, & Classic Alternative). Optional Alpha textures (Courtesy of Golden Days).](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1003617/description_a27f5865-71d9-4dfe-a0fa-12bcbd54c55a.png)

* [Golden Days](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/golden-days) * [Programmer Art Ultimate](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/programmer-art-ultimate-1-17/) * [Minecraft: Classic Edition](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/minecraft-classic-edition-6131290/) * [Programmer Art Continuation Project](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/programmer-art-continuation-project/) * [Classic Alternative](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/classic-alternative/) * [Old Stonecutter](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/old-stonecutter-animated/)   ***   ### ![New niches for materials. Leather armor provides more movement speed. Chainmail armor gives more projectile protection. Golden armor gives luck & has buffed stats, almost to diamond level, but with the same crappy durability. Golden tools have silk touch by default. Diamond armor gives more blast protection. Diamond tools have efficiency by default. Tungsten armor gives more fire protection &, much like Tungsten tools, has unbreaking by default.](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1003617/description_5bc912a6-404a-42f7-9611-403c8459d28f.png)    ***   ### Completely new content. * **More in-depth food system** with Farmer's Delight (Retextured to fit Beta aesthetic). * **Several dumb-fun features and utilities** with Supplementaries (Retextured to fit Beta aesthetic). * **Backpacks** with INMIS. * **The Aether** (C'mon. I had to include it). * **Copper armor & tools**. Copper tools have _fortune/looting_ by default. * **Reworked structures** with YUNG's mods. * Reworked Ender Dragon fight with [True Ending: Ender Dragon Overhaul](https://modrinth.com/datapack/true-ending) by _limesplatus_. * **Overhauled Nether** with Amplified Nether.

**And more!**

Have a suggestion for a mod which you believe would fit this modpack? Any issues in balance or features that can use more fleshing out? **Let me know!**

  ***
